assumptions: device_orders.product_l1 是产品一级分类的权威字段（见 glossary），无需连接 product_master
year_month 为 YYYYMM 整数，2026 年上半年即 202601 到 202606 含边界
取消单 status='cancelled' 不计入，仅统计 status='confirmed' 的订单
金额单位为 CNY，沿用演示口径
writer_output.sql: SELECT product_l1, SUM(order_amount) AS device_order_amount, SUM(profit_amount) AS device_profit_amount FROM device_orders WHERE org_code = 'ORG_1001' AND year_month BETWEEN 202601 AND 202606 AND status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY product_l1
writer_output.explanation: 按设备订货事实表 device_orders 的 product_l1 分组，显式限定 org_code='ORG_1001'、year_month 在 202601 至 202606 之间、status='confirmed'，对 order_amount 求和得到设备订货金额、对 profit_amount 求和得到设备利润。device_orders 自身已含 product_l1，故不引入 product_master 连接。

final_sql: SELECT product_l1, SUM(order_amount) AS device_order_amount, SUM(profit_amount) AS device_profit_amount FROM device_orders WHERE org_code = 'ORG_1001' AND year_month BETWEEN 202601 AND 202606 AND status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY product_l1
